system.description:
Lore: Relic Globe

A glass sphere the size of a fist that follows its owner around like a patient dog. It has the following Powers:

  • Radiant I: Speak the command word to make it shed sunlight out to Close, and again to douse it.
  • Levitation: The globe itself hovers, and follows within Close of whoever spoke the command word. It can be sent up to Far away and recalled.

Value: 2500g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
